worst.enc: The king made beams with the wood-almug.  And the king used those beams [in-order-to make the temple of Yahweh and the royal house of the king].  And those structures were strong because of those beams.  The king also made harps and lyres for people[who played music] with the wood-almug.  (alt) The king also made instruments[that had strings] for people[who played music] with the wood-almug.  The amount of wood-almug[that Hiram's ships brought to Judah] is more-than any amount of wood-almug[that people have brought to Judah since that time].  And people have not seen that amount of wood-almug in Judah since that time.
worst.bt: The king made beams with the wood almug. And the king used those beams in order to make the temple of the LORD and the royal house of the king. And those structures were strong because of those beams. The king also made harps and lyres for people[ that who played music with the wood almug. (alt) The king also made instruments[ that that had strings for people[ that who played music with the wood almug. The amount of wood-almug[ that Hiram's ships brought to Judah is more than any amount of wood-almug[ that that people have brought to Judah since that time. And people have not seen that amount of wood almug in Judah since that time.

worst.enc: Since the time [when our(Ezra's) ancestors lived] until this time, we(Ezra) are guilty [of doing many bad-B things]. Because of our(Ezra's) bad-B actions, we(Ezra), our(Ezra's) kings, and our(Ezra's) priests were killed with swords by enemies _implicitActveAgent. And we(Ezra), our(Ezra's) kings, and our(Ezra's) priests were take-away/captured by enemies _implicitActiveAgent. Our(Israelites') land and our(Israelites') possessions were take-away by enemies _implicitActiveAgent. And we(Israelites) were caused [to be ashamed] by enemies _implictActiveAgent. These things were done by the hand of _litearlExpansion other/foreign kings. These things are the same things today.
worst.bt: Since the time when our ancestors lived until this time, we are guilty of doing many bad things. Because of our bad actions, we, our kings, and our priests were killed with swords <<by enemies>>. And we, our kings, and our priests were captured <<by enemies>>. Our land and our possessions were take away <<by enemies>>. And we were caused to be ashamed by enemies. These things were done by the hand of foreign kings. These things are the same things today.
